import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback

def flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

def jsonContent = null
session.read(flowFile, { inputStream ->
    jsonContent = inputStream.text
} as InputStreamCallback)

def json = new JsonSlurper().parseText(jsonContent)
def responseBody = json.ResponseBody
flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { out ->
    out.write(responseBody.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as OutputStreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback

flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

def content = ''
session.read(flowFile, { inputStream ->
    content = new String(inputStream.bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
} as InputStreamCallback)

def jsonSlurper = new JsonSlurper()
def root = jsonSlurper.parseText(content)

def flatList = []
def flattenCategory

// Hàm đệ quy duyệt cây và trải phẳng
flattenCategory = { category, parentId = null ->
    def record = [
        id: category.id,
        parent_id: parentId,
        name: category.name,
        url_key: category.url_key,
        url_path: category.url_path,
        level: category.level,
        is_leaf: category.is_leaf,
        product_count: category.product_count,
        thumbnail_url: category.thumbnail_url
    ]
    flatList << record

    // Duyệt các danh mục con nếu có
    if (category.children && category.children.size() > 0) {
        category.children.each { child ->
            flattenCategory(child, category.id)
        }
    }
}

flattenCategory(root)

def flatJson = JsonOutput.toJson(flatList)

flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { outputStream ->
    outputStream.write(flatJson.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as OutputStreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper

flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

// Lấy attribute sellerName trước khi xử lý nội dung
def sellerName = flowFile.getAttribute("sellerName") ?: ""
def requestUrl = "https://www.lazada.vn/${sellerName}/?ajax=true&from=wangpu&isFirstRequest=true&langFlag=en&page=1&pageTypeId=2&q=All-Products"

// Gán attribute RequestUrl mới
flowFile = session.putAttribute(flowFile, "RequestUrl", requestUrl)

flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { inputStream, outputStream -> 
    def text = inputStream.getText('UTF-8')
    def originalJson = new JsonSlurper().parseText(text)

    // Lấy giá trị ResponseBody từ JSON ban đầu
    def responseBody = originalJson.ResponseBody

    // Tạo JSON hard-code và gộp với responseBody
    def hardCodedJson = [
        RequestUrl: requestUrl,
        RequestDomain: "lazada.vn",
        RequestHeaders: [
            "accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*",
            "accept-language": "vi,en;q=0.9",
            "dnt": "1",
            "priority": "u=1, i",
            "sec-ch-ua": "",
            "sec-ch-ua-mobile": "?0",
            "sec-ch-ua-platform": "",
            "sec-fetch-dest": "empty",
            "sec-fetch-mode": "cors",
            "sec-fetch-site": "same-origin",
            "user-agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/135.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
            "x-csrf-token": "e350348eeebb1"
        ],
        ResponseBody: responseBody
    ]

    // Chuyển thành JSON đẹp
    def finalJson = JsonOutput.prettyPrint(JsonOutput.toJson(hardCodedJson))

    // Ghi ra output stream
    outputStream.write(finalJson.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as StreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.time.OffsetDateTime
import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback

flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return


def content = ''
session.read(flowFile, { inputStream ->
    content = new String(inputStream.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
} as InputStreamCallback)

def json = new JsonSlurper().parseText(content)
if (json.uid) {
	json.url = "https://zalo.me/" + json.uid
	json.phones = [json.uid]
}
json.created_time = OffsetDateTime.now().toString()
def updatedContent = JsonOutput.toJson(json)

flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { out ->
    out.write(updatedContent.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as OutputStreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

So objectively, this data may not 100% picture the reality.\", \"modifiers\": {}}], \"indent\": 0, \"quoted\": false, \"type\": \"plain\", \"is_rtl\": false}, {\"spans\": [{\"text\": \"However, it is worthy to note about the Southeast Asian context of the question - I second \", \"modifiers\": {}}, {\"text\": \"Steven de Guzman\", \"modifiers\": {\"link\": {\"type\": \"user\", \"uid\": 5430486, \"url\": \"https://www.quora.com/profile/Steven-de-Guzman\"}}}, {\"text\": \" how Indonesian multilingualism is confined within its own borders; we already speak Indonesian and our mother/regional language, so English is just the crowning of it. In Singapore & Malaysia, since English is instituted in their education they have an international advantage. I noticed among my Singapore-Malaysian friends using English in their written assignment/speeches, most of the time they have more elaborate vocabularies/phrases than other fluent English-speaking Asians\", \"modifiers\": {}}], \"indent\": 0, \"quoted\": false, \"type\": \"plain\", \"is_rtl\": false}, {\"spans\": [{\"text\": \"Yet still, likewise the case in Indonesia, ordinary Singaporeans and Malaysians does not speak proper English - they do speak Singlish or another kind of \", \"modifiers\": {}}, {\"text\": \"Bahasa Rojak\", \"modifiers\": {\"italic\": true}}, {\"text\": \" / mixed-up language.                                                 "content": "{\"sections\": [{\"spans\": [{\"text\": \"If you\\u2019re going for a two week holiday on one of the very popular tourist destinations, then you\\u2019ll get along fine with English. import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback

def flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

def jsonContent = null
session.read(flowFile, { inputStream ->
    jsonContent = inputStream.text
} as InputStreamCallback)

def json = new JsonSlurper().parseText(jsonContent)
def responseBody = json.ResponseBody
flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { out ->
    out.write(responseBody.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as OutputStreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

His mother's heart had given out that morning while getting dressed for court. He's destroying himself.\\\"\\n\\nJudge Vance—known for his no-nonsense approach but also his fairness—faced a choice. He could let the system handle it: send the chaplain, file the paperwork, move on to the next case.\\n\\nInstead, he did something extraordinary.\\n\\nStill wearing his black robes, the judge walked down to the cell block—a place judges simply don't go. He sat on the metal cot next to Tyrell and gently took the teenager's cuffed hands.\\n\\n\\\"Look at me, son,\\\" Judge Vance said softly. \\\"Your mother didn't raise you for this moment to define you. She raised you for what comes next.\\\"\\n\\nThrough his tears, Tyrell choked out, \\\"She's gone because of what I did.\\\"\\n\\n\\\"You made mistakes,\\\" the judge replied. \\\"But you're 19 years old. Your story isn't over—it's just beginning. And I'm going to help you write the next chapter.\\\"\\n\\nJudge Vance personally arranged Tyrell's temporary release for the funeral. But he didn't stop there. He promised to visit Tyrell in prison monthly and personally review his case for early release if he stayed clean and worked hard.\\n\\nWhen reporters later asked Judge Vance why he went so far beyond his duties, he simply said: \\\"Sometimes justice isn't just about the sentence. Somebody had to step in.\\\"\\n\\nThree months later, Tyrell is a model inmate, earning his GED and mentoring younger inmates. import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper

flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

// Lấy attribute sellerName trước khi xử lý nội dung
def sellerName = flowFile.getAttribute("sellerName") ?: ""
def requestUrl = "https://www.lazada.vn/${sellerName}/?ajax=true&from=wangpu&isFirstRequest=true&langFlag=en&page=1&pageTypeId=2&q=All-Products"

// Gán attribute RequestUrl mới
flowFile = session.putAttribute(flowFile, "RequestUrl", requestUrl)

flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { inputStream, outputStream -> 
    def text = inputStream.getText('UTF-8')
    def originalJson = new JsonSlurper().parseText(text)

    // Lấy giá trị ResponseBody từ JSON ban đầu
    def responseBody = originalJson.ResponseBody

    // Tạo JSON hard-code và gộp với responseBody
    def hardCodedJson = [
        RequestUrl: requestUrl,
        RequestDomain: "lazada.vn",
        RequestHeaders: [
            "accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*",
            "accept-language": "vi,en;q=0.9",
            "dnt": "1",
            "priority": "u=1, i",
            "sec-ch-ua": "",
            "sec-ch-ua-mobile": "?0",
            "sec-ch-ua-platform": "",
            "sec-fetch-dest": "empty",
            "sec-fetch-mode": "cors",
            "sec-fetch-site": "same-origin",
            "user-agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/135.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
            "x-csrf-token": "e350348eeebb1"
        ],
        ResponseBody: responseBody
    ]

    // Chuyển thành JSON đẹp
    def finalJson = JsonOutput.prettyPrint(JsonOutput.toJson(hardCodedJson))

    // Ghi ra output stream
    outputStream.write(finalJson.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as StreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback

flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

def content = ''
session.read(flowFile, { inputStream ->
    content = new String(inputStream.bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
} as InputStreamCallback)

def jsonSlurper = new JsonSlurper()
def root = jsonSlurper.parseText(content)

def flatList = []
def flattenCategory

// Hàm đệ quy duyệt cây và trải phẳng
flattenCategory = { category, parentId = null ->
    def record = [
        id: category.id,
        parent_id: parentId,
        name: category.name,
        url_key: category.url_key,
        url_path: category.url_path,
        level: category.level,
        is_leaf: category.is_leaf,
        product_count: category.product_count,
        thumbnail_url: category.thumbnail_url
    ]
    flatList << record

    // Duyệt các danh mục con nếu có
    if (category.children && category.children.size() > 0) {
        category.children.each { child ->
            flattenCategory(child, category.id)
        }
    }
}

flattenCategory(root)

def flatJson = JsonOutput.toJson(flatList)

flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { outputStream ->
    outputStream.write(flatJson.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as OutputStreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)
